summary: Frontend-only polish verification. Guest login → Profile → Premium flow tested on mobile viewport (390x844). All 4 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) Profile avatar shows letter 'G' (from user.name='Guest') — no '?' character. (2) Display name row renders '🌱  Guest' with seedling emoji prefix. (3) Email row correctly shows 'Guest account'. (4) Premium plan cards render INR pricing exactly as requested: ₹149/month, ₹899/year (Save 50%), ₹1,999 one-time — 'Best value' badge is on Yearly, and Yearly is selected by default (per code default state). No '$' USD symbol found anywhere on premium screen. Regression: home tab navigation and profile navigation working; app loaded cleanly with no red-box errors. Code inspection also confirms null-user fallback path (user?.name ? user.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : nameEmoji) → when user is null, avatarChar becomes '🌱' and displayName='Guest', yielding the requested '🌱  Guest' name row + 🌱 avatar (verified in code, could not directly reproduce a null-user runtime state since guest login succeeded).
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx (line 21): avatarChar logic correctly gates on user?.name — when user is null the '🌱' emoji is used; when user.name='Guest' (from AuthContext for guest sessions), 'G' is shown. Both behaviors match the spec.
premium/index.tsx (lines 23-27): PLANS array now uses INR prices with ₹ symbol; verified rendered exactly as ₹149, ₹899, ₹1,999 in the UI.

Non-blocking console warnings observed (pre-existing, not related to this iteration): 'shadow*' style props deprecated; Image.style.resizeMode deprecated; props.pointerEvents deprecated (profile.tsx line 126 uses pointerEvents as a prop on the toast View). Consider moving to style.pointerEvents in a future pass — not blocking.
